ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: IF( INCLUDES(Closed_Lost_Reason__c, "Budget cut"), NOT( OR( INCLUDES(Closed_Lost_Reason__c, "No ROI/not worth cost"), INCLUDES(Closed_Lost_Reason__c, "Not producing content/didn't write"), INCLUDES(Closed_Lost_Reason__c, "Don't know what to do with data"), INCLUDES(Closed_Lost_Reason__c, "No response/no reason given"), INCLUDES(Closed_Lost_Reason__c, "Change of content strategy"), INCLUDES(Closed_Lost_Reason__c, "Issues with LBR service"), INCLUDES(Closed_Lost_Reason__c, "Wrong audience reading"), INCLUDES(Closed_Lost_Reason__c, "Change in audience targeting"), INCLUDES(Closed_Lost_Reason__c, "Consolidating Lexology products"), INCLUDES(Closed_Lost_Reason__c, "Switching to competitor"), INCLUDES(Closed_Lost_Reason__c, "Primary contact/purchaser left/not in budget"), INCLUDES(Closed_Lost_Reason__c, "Bad debtor"), INCLUDES(Closed_Lost_Reason__c, "Persistent product issues"), INCLUDES(Closed_Lost_Reason__c, "Dissolved/Merged"), INCLUDES(Closed_Lost_Reason__c, "Data not detailed enough"), INCLUDES(Closed_Lost_Reason__c, "No time to make use of data/tools") ) ), false ) && text(StageName)="Closed Lost" && text( Opportunity_Type_Forecast__c )= "Renewal" && Owner.Business_Group__c ="Market Intelligence"
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Budget Cut cannot be selected as a Closed Lost Reason on its own – please add at least one other Closed Lost Reason
